facts.statement: The study used high-resolution imaging to watch pioneer axons move and connect with other cells in the inner ear.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: Researchers found that the chemical signal Cxcl14 directs pioneer axons to grow, turn, and bundle together correctly.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: When Cxcl14 was removed, axons failed to navigate properly, hair cell connections were damaged, and hearing-related behaviors were impaired.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The study shows that pioneer axons are necessary for both the growth of other axons and the movement of other neurons.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: The authors conclude that their results define a new way that chemical signals help build the early sensory circuits needed for hearing.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue
